name: laeral silverhand
lore:
To encounter Laeral Silverhand is to stand before the living history of the Realms. Though she walks the marble halls of Waterdeep as its Open Lord, her true ecology is the Weave itself; she breathes magic as mortals breathe mountain air. 

In behavior, she is a study in tempered silver—radiating a stillness that belies the arcane storm beneath her skin. She moves with the grace of a queen and the vigilance of a sentinel, her silver hair a beacon amidst the gray shadows of politics. While she offers counsel with the patience of centuries, do not mistake her diplomacy for frailty. Like the deep currents of the Sea of Swords, she is profound, cool to her enemies, and utterly unyielding. To seek her is to seek the heart of the North; to cross her is to invite the silent wrath of Mystra herself.
